extraction.name: Science Question Answering (SCIENCEQA)
extraction.description: A benchmark of about 21k multimodal multiple-choice science questions with diverse topics, annotated with corresponding lectures and explanations for the answers. It is collected from elementary and high school science curricula and includes rich domain diversity.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed by downloading original science problems from open educational resources managed by IXL Learning, extracting components such as questions, hints, images, options, answers, lectures, and solutions using heuristic rules, then manually removing invalid or duplicate questions, keeping one correct answer when multiple applied, shuffling answer options, reformatting lectures and solutions with semi-automated scripts, and manually reviewing and revising incorrect annotations with experts.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Original science problems from open resources managed by IXL Learning, including components such as questions, hints, images, options, answers, lectures, and solutions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Questions were sourced from existing educational materials, components including answers, lectures, and solutions were extracted using heuristic rules, invalid items were manually removed, lectures and solutions were reformatted with semi-automated scripts, and incorrect annotations were manually revised by experts after review with a data exploration tool.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Data quality was ensured through review with a data exploration tool and expert manual revision of incorrect annotations.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Heuristic rules and semi-automated scripts were used to extract and reformat annotation components.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for science-based question answering, diagnosing multi-hop reasoning ability and interpretability of AI systems, establishing baselines, and studying explanation generation and chain-of-thought reasoning.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The paper states that the data and code are available online.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Shuffled answer options for each question; randomly split the dataset into training, validation, and test sets with a 60:20:20 ratio.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Downloaded original science problems, extracted components using heuristic rules, manually removed invalid/faulty/duplicate questions, kept only one correct answer when multiple applied, reformatted lectures and solutions with semi-automated scripts, manually revised incorrect annotations, replaced newline separators with escaped newlines for language model encoding, and replaced missing context text with an empty string for questions without context.
